text:
mira: quick ping — PR #2143 (service/auth): import order + blankline nits from last review. CI is failing with flake8/isort. Any blockers to me pushing an auto-fix using `isort --profile black` and `pre-commit` hooks? :wave:

alex: saw the PR. main nit is mixed relative/absolute imports in `auth/handlers.py`. prefer grouped: stdlib, third-party, internal. also trailing blank line at end of file.

sam: I can do a small follow-up if you want, otherwise go for auto-fix. watch out for `from . import utils` vs `import service.utils` — we prefer explicit relative.

mira: thanks — I'll run `isort --profile black` and `ruff --fix` locally, then push a single commit. i'll also add `.isort.cfg` with:
```
[settings]
profile = "black"
line_length = 88
```

alex: sg. please keep changes limited to style (no logic edits). add a changelog entry? not necessary for tiny nits.

ci-bot: [CI] build #452 failed — flake8: auth/handlers.py:12:1 F401 'math' imported but unused
ci-bot: [CI] build #452 failed — isort: auth/handlers.py Imports are incorrectly sorted.

sam: that F401 was from a debug import; I'll remove it in the fix.

mira: pushed `style/2143-isort-fix` branch with autoformatted files, force-pushed after ruff fix.

alex: quick glance looks fine. Can you re-run tests? I saw one unit flake in `tests/test_auth.py` — maybe snapshot changes.

devops-bot: re-run triggered by @mira

ci-bot: [CI] build #453 — all checks passed :white_check_mark:

alex: Approved. :thumbsup:

mira: merging into main during today's merge window (17:30 PT). ping me if anything weird.

sam: thanks all — noted for future PRs to run `pre-commit run --all-files` locally.

mira: added pre-commit config to repo and a short note in CONTRIBUTING.md. closing the thread.
